doc.snippet: NFR3 requires retry logic for transient network failures: retry failed API calls up to 3 times with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s), only retry on network errors (Timeout, ConnectionError), not on business logic errors (400, 401, 403)

artifact.reason: Reference implementation for HTTP helper - 90% reusable pattern showing shared httpx client usage, header construction, method handling (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), response status compatibility
Shared HTTP client with connection pooling that must be used by the HTTP helper - provides automatic protocol negotiation, connection pooling (20 keepalive, 50 max), 120s timeout
Existing Jainam modules that will be refactored to use the new HTTP helper - currently make direct httpx calls that need to be replaced with centralized helper
Base URL configuration that HTTP helper will use - replaces hardcoded INTERACTIVE_URL pattern from FivePaisaXTS
Logging utility for structured logging in HTTP helper - will log endpoint, method, status, latency, attempt for each API call

package.name: httpx
package.usage: HTTP client library - shared client with connection pooling and retry support

constraints.constraint: HTTP helper must use shared httpx client from utils.httpx_client.get_httpx_client() - DO NOT create new httpx clients
Configuration values must be loaded from broker/jainam_prop/api/config.py and support environment variable overrides
Retry logic must ONLY retry on network errors (Timeout, ConnectionError, 5xx, 429) - DO NOT retry on business logic errors (400, 401, 403)
Response object must include response.status attribute for backward compatibility with existing codebase
Structured logging must include: endpoint, method, status, latency, attempt number for debugging and monitoring
Function signature must match pattern: get_api_response(endpoint, auth, method="GET", payload=None, retries=3, backoff_min=0.25, backoff_max=2.0)
All refactored modules (order_api.py, data.py, funds.py) must use the helper - NO direct httpx calls should remain
Dealer account clientID parameter must be preserved in all API calls - critical for Pro/Normal dealer accounts

tests.standards: Testing standards from Dev Notes: - Unit tests in broker/jainam_prop/api/test_http_helper.py with pytest - Test successful API call (happy path with 200 response) - Test retry logic on 500 error with exponential backoff verification (delays: 0.25s, 0.5s, 1.0s) - Test no retry on client errors (400, 401, 403 should fail immediately) - Test retry on network errors (Timeout, ConnectionError exceptions) - Integration tests in broker/jainam_prop/test_order_api_refactored.py - Test order book retrieval with retry logic using real Jainam API - Test order placement with retry logic (POST) using real Jainam API - Coverage target: >90% for http_helper.py - Use mocking for unit tests (httpx.Client.get/post), real API for integration tests

Unit test: Mock 400 error response, verify NO retry (immediate failure), verify single log entry

Unit test: Mock 429 rate limit error, verify retry with exponential backoff

Integration test: Place test order using HTTP helper, verify order ID returned, verify dealer clientID preserved in request
Integration test: Call get_quotes() from data.py using HTTP helper, verify market data token usage
Integration test: Call get_margin() from funds.py using HTTP helper, verify response format
Unit test: Verify config values loaded from environment variables (JAINAM_RETRY_ATTEMPTS, JAINAM_RETRY_BACKOFF_MIN, JAINAM_RETRY_BACKOFF_MAX)
